newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptians fake blindness to enter university.
newsitem.headline: Egyptians fake blindness to enter university.

text.p: Egyptian youngsters have found an ingenious way to win a place in university despite low grades -- pretending they are blind.

Abdelwahhab Abdelhafez, president of Ain Shams university in Cairo, said in an interview published on Friday that out of 90 students enrolled this year under the special scheme for the blind, 25 turned out to be frauds.
"Precise visual devices proved they were pretending. The centres from which they came will be investigated," he told the government newspaper al-Ahram.

In one faculty, for example, an average of 50 percent in secondary school exams ensured a university place for the blind and other handicapped people. Other students needed an average of at least 85 percent, he said.
